subject: Mythology
title: Savitri and the God of Death
description: A micro-lesson that makes Savitri and the God of Death usable.

hook.text: Savitri followed the god of death into the underworld and argued him into giving her dead husband back.

buildup.text: She chose to marry Satyavan despite knowing a prophecy said he would die exactly one year after their wedding.

discovery.text: When Yama, god of death, arrived to take his soul, Savitri walked behind him, refusing to let her husband go.

twist.text: She outsmarted Yama by asking for boons so cleverly that only returning Satyavan's life could fulfill them all.

climax.text: Impressed by her devotion and intelligence, Yama restored Satyavan to life — the only time death was reversed.

quiz.question: How did Savitri get her husband back from Yama?
options: She outsmarted him by asking for cleverly worded boons
She offered her own life in exchange
